name: session_prepare_with_backup
description: Create and verify an independent backup before beginning a staged edit.

steps.purpose: Before editing, make an independent copy of the target using an authorized backup method and location appropriate to the host. Verify the backup bytes; stop if the copy or verification fails.
Read and follow the staged session preparation procedure after verifying the backup.

limits: Guidance only. The registry does not create or verify the backup through this recipe; no machine-specific path or shell command is supplied.
